scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -n types,api,web,admin -c blue,yellow,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared-types" "npm run dev -w services/api-backend" "npm run dev -w apps/web-store" "npm run dev -w apps/admin-dashboard"
scripts.clean: find . -name 'dist' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name '.next' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name 'node_modules' -exec rm -rf {} +
